segments.title: Free trials RENEW on their own
segments.say: Free trials on your iPhone renew on their own. Check this one screen.

segments.title: Find it in 2 taps
segments.say: Open Settings, tap your name, then tap Subscriptions.

segments.title: Cancel what you don't use
segments.say: Tap any subscription you don't want, then tap Cancel Subscription.

segments.title: Trial? Cancel 24 hours early
segments.say: On a free trial? Apple says cancel at least twenty four hours before it ends.
Follow for Phone Trick number 15 tomorrow.
